Firing-order consistency of initiation zones from replication states

Source: R/izones.R
calculate_firing_order.Rd

IZs are ordered by decreasing rt (earliest first). For each cell with rep_percent in rep_range (inclusive), the state of the bin containing each IZ centre is read (cells with less than 90% non-NA IZ states are set to NA); if K IZs are fired (state 4), the first K IZs in timing order are expected to be fired. Observed (4 fired, 2 unfired) and expected states are cross-tabulated per IZ.

Usage

calculate_firing_order(
  izs,
  genobins_rep_states,
  meta_data,
  rep_range = c(0, 1)
)

Arguments

izs

GRanges of IZs with a numeric rt column (no NA).

genobins_rep_states

Matrix of states, bins x cells, with row names "chr-start-end"; every IZ centre must lie in exactly one bin.

meta_data

A data.frame with columns cell_id (covering all matrix columns) and rep_percent in [0, 1].

rep_range

Inclusive rep_percent range of the cells used.

Value

A numeric matrix, one row per IZ in timing order (row names "chr:start-end"), with the percentages observed_fired_expected_fired, observed_unfired_expected_unfired, observed_fired_expected_unfired and observed_unfired_expected_fired (NA if an IZ has no observation).
